items.claim: CFO 給出 2026 年調整後 EBITDA 指引區間
items.quote: we are guiding $645 million to $660 million
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 給出 2026 年 non-GAAP EPS 指引區間
items.quote: non-GAAP earnings per share guidance of $4.55 to $4.70
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 給出 2026 年自由現金流指引區間
items.quote: free cash flow of $305 million to $320 million
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 說明 2026 年 Commercial Operations 部門利潤率預期上升幅度
items.quote: margin to increase by roughly 100 basis points
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 說明 2026 年 Government Operations 利潤率因新專案而略降
items.quote: we expect margin to be slightly lower
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 回覆分析師關於政府業務利潤率是否於 2026 年見底的提問，表示對現行定價協議有信心
items.quote: we feel really good about the current pricing agreement.
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CEO 回覆對 AP1000 組件標案在北美與歐洲的競爭定位提問，表示公司不特別偏重特定地區
items.quote: geographic agnostic when it comes to component supply
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: 分析師提問時指出 BWXT 未投標波蘭 AP1000 蒸汽產生器供應商標案
items.quote: I know you guys didn't bid on that.
items.speaker: Analyst (Jan-Frans Engelbrecht)

items.claim: CFO 說明可轉債交易將轉換價格提高至超過 $396
items.quote: increased the conversion price to over $396
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CFO 回覆資本部署優先順序提問，表示 M&A 將持續是資本部署策略的重要部分
items.quote: M&A as a big part of our capital deployment strategy.
items.speaker: CFO (Michael Fitzgerald)

items.claim: CEO 說明 Project Pele 的 TRISO 燃料首批核心已交付愛達荷國家實驗室
items.quote: delivered the first core of TRISO fuel for Project Pele
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 說明 Antares 反應爐預計於今年 7 月 4 日前達到臨界
items.quote: aims to achieve reactor criticality by July 4 of this year
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 回覆美加關係與關稅提問，表示醫療產品及核能組件在 USMCA 框架下目前無關稅
items.quote: there are no tariffs in that framework on medical products
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 回覆加拿大競爭局對 Kinectrics 收購案調查進度提問，表示目前沒有新消息
items.quote: It's been pretty quiet on our front. No news on that one.
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 說明由 BWXT Laurentis Energy Partners 領軍的團隊獲選為保加利亞 Kozloduy 兩座 AP1000 機組提供業主工程師服務
items.quote: provide owners engineer services for 2 proposed AP1000
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 說明公司已就海軍推進設備與燃料簽署新的定價協議
items.quote: secured new pricing agreements for naval propulsion
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

items.claim: CEO 說明公司年底在手訂單金額達 73 億美元，年增 50%
items.speaker: CEO (Rex Geveden)

qa_flags.question: Is there any update on when we could see approval of Tech 99.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 未給時間表，強調「imperfect clarity」，反覆提到產品品質/過濾濃縮問題仍在解決中，尚未向 FDA 送件；且連續數季重複「not much new」的措辭
